captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a bicycle dropper seatpost assembly. It features a bottom-most grey frame seat-tube sleeve adapter, a black middle collar clamp with a pivoting quick-release binder lever, a black outer post, and a silver inner telescoping post with height markings. The top of the inner post is fitted with a dual-bolt black saddle clamp assembly. The assembly has two points of articulation: the inner tube slides telescopically inside the outer tube (prismatic joint), and the quick-release binder lever rotates on its pivot pin (revolute joint).
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bicycle dropper seatpost assembly. The model must include a lower grey frame sleeve adapter, a black collar clamp with a pivoting quick-release lever, a black outer post, and a telescoping silver inner tube with height markings topped by a two-bolt saddle clamp. Establish a prismatic joint for the telescoping inner tube and a revolute joint for the quick-release lever.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by modeling several distinct parts. The sleeve adapter and outer post are created using nested cylinders, with the collar clamp featuring a cut-out slot and mounting ears. The quick-release lever is designed using a sketch extruded to form a cam profile and handle, which is attached via a revolute joint. The telescoping inner post is a silver cylinder decorated with thin black ring cuts for height increments, topped with a rectangular saddle rail clamp block and two vertical bolts. Prismatic and revolute joints are defined using local coordinate systems to enable physical simulation of the dropper extension and clamp locking.
